quests.name: Trouble with Ghosts
quests.summary: The banker wants the ghost near Sarnwick thinned out.
intro: The ghost beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 11 of them close to Sarnwick and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Coal
quests.summary: The general store keeper of Sarnwick has run out of coal.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 22 coal and nobody in Sarnwick has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Magic Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Sarnwick to the magic shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the magic shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the barber.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Clothes Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the clothes shop keeper of Sarnwick and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the clothes shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Sarnwick Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Sarnwick Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Sarnwick Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Zombies
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper wants the zombie near Sarnwick thinned out.
intro: The zombie beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 11 of them close to Sarnwick and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Steel Bar
quests.summary: The clothes shop keeper of Sarnwick has run out of steel bar.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 11 steel bar and nobody in Sarnwick has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Armour Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Sarnwick to the armour shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the armour shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the food shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Sweeping the Sarnwick Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant spider out of Sarnwick Sewers and tell the general store keeper.
intro: Sarnwick Sewers is crawling with giant spider, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 18 of them, then let the general store keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Sarnwick owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Sarnwick Sewers is clearer than it was. 18 giant spider fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Velneir
quests.summary: Gather coal for the general store keeper, then carry a shipment to Velneir.
intro: I have an order from Velneir and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 22 coal, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the general store keeper in Sarnwick.
From Sarnwick? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Sarnwick and bring back steel bar.
intro: The wilds around Sarnwick need a firm hand. Start with 11 zombie outside the walls, then 18 giant spider down in Sarnwick Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 11 steel bar to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Sarnwick for the sword shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the food shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the armour shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the food shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

Bring me 13 big bones, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the magic shop keeper in Sarnwick.
From Sarnwick? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt (Clothes Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Sarnwick and bring back coal.

When that is done, bring me 22 coal to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Stonejaw Depths, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Stonejaw Depths has stood against Sarnwick for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the sword shop keeper, fight your way through 26 cave crawler and end The Broodmother.
Bring 22 coal back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Stonejaw Depths?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Sarnwick: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Sarnwick Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Sarnwick and Velneir.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Velneir. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 26 zombie near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the sword shop keeper in Sarnwick.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Velneir is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Sarnwick has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Sarnwick
quests.summary: Find what rules Sarnwick Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Sarnwick Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the general store keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Sarnwick is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Sarnwick Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.
